items.title: Albert French Interview
items.q: I took lessons from Willie Foster. And Willie Foster is a fine teacher too, very fine teacher.

ctx.x: The only one we found that day was Willie Foster the guitar. He's in Baton Rouge. He's up there. He's in Baton Rouge. Taking care of his mother.
Well I was wondering where Willie Foster was.
I'm trying to think if their mother has died. She was 106 years old. She must be dead. I think she died since then.
